title: Celestin's rhythm section
summary: Camilla Todd on piano, bass players, guitarist Tom Benton and drummer Bill Matthews.

blocks.x: Who did Celestan have in the rhythm section?

Well, that lady on piano, Clown's sister, Camilla Todd, is that her name? Mm-hmm. Now, who was on bass? Chester Zadis played bass with him, why? But before that he had George Foster, that's right. He was- He was-
He was the same one was with Jack Carey, huh? Yeah, same one.

Same guy. Yeah. And guitar, Tom Benton. Boy, he's getting me back there to think now. I got to think about them kind of fellas, you know, Tom Benton, yeah that was his guitar player. Played with him a long time.
Did he have a good drummer then?
Yeah, this guy played a drum with him. Bill Matthews.
I still played a drum with him. Dick, you sure are calling me back. Yeah, now you're making me get some stuff.
